name: parimelazhagar_struct
description: Parimelazhagar's commentary read as data, by rule: the kural's words in his prose order with his gloss for each phrase, the situation note (turai) for the love verses, how he groups kurals inside a chapter, his statement of what a verse teaches, the variant readings he reports and his stance on them, the other commentators he cites, and the figures, grammar and works he names. Every value is a span copied from the commentary in parimelazhagar_ta (same carrier, same MIT terms, same unidentified printed edition); nothing is paraphrased and no model is involved.

fields.name: kural_id
fields.description: Kural id; joins kurals.id and parimelazhagar_ta.kural_id.

fields.name: coverage
fields.description: As in parimelazhagar_ta: complete, partial (the word gloss is missing in the carrier) or missing (the carrier row is withheld and nothing is kept from it).

fields.name: pada_urai
fields.description: Word-by-word commentary in his order: head = the kural's words as he splits them (sandhi undone), gloss = his explanation of that phrase.

fields.name: turai
fields.description: Situation note as written at the head of the row (who speaks, to whom, when); love section only. Null if none.

fields.name: turai_resolved
fields.description: The situation note that applies: turai itself, or the one 'இதுவும் அது' (same as above) points back to. Null when the note it points to is in a withheld row.

fields.name: turai_same_as
fields.description: Kural id whose note 'இதுவும் அது' refers to; null when the note is the row's own.

fields.name: group_end
fields.description: Set on the last kural of a group: 'இவை N பாட்டானும் … கூறப்பட்டது', the N kurals ending here treat one sub-topic.

fields.name: summary
fields.description: His sentences stating what this verse establishes ('இதனான் … கூறப்பட்டது').

fields.name: other_commentators
fields.description: Sentences reporting other commentators' readings or interpretations ('… என்பாரும் உளர்').

fields.name: reported_readings
fields.description: Variant readings he reports. stance: reported (others read it), also_a_reading (he admits it), conditional (he explains it if read so), rejected (he argues against it). Fragments, not full verses; they do not touch the canonical text.

fields.name: figures
fields.description: Figures of speech he names (உவமை, உருவகம், உபசாரம், எடுத்துக்காட்டு). Precise but sparse: many figures he does not name.

fields.name: grammar_notes
fields.description: Grammar he points out (ஆகுபெயர், உம்மை, அசைநிலை, தொகை …), first sentence per term.

fields.name: cites_works
fields.description: Other works he cites (Tolkappiyam, Sanskrit treatises …).

fields.name: head_letter_coverage
fields.description: Share of the kural's letters the heads reproduce, order-free: a parse check, 1.0 = every letter accounted for.

fields.name: flags
fields.description: Carrier faults and parse notes: vilakkam_unclosed, turai_missing_open_paren, leading_paren_not_turai, no_word_gloss_marker, head_found_by_verse_words (no separator before a head, so its start was found by matching the verse), head_boundary_unclear, heads_carry_extra_words (the carrier repeats a phrase, so a head holds words that are not the verse's), withheld and commentary_of_<kural id> (the carrier row is another kural's commentary), turai_refers_to_withheld_row ('same as above' after a withheld row, so turai_resolved is null).

fields.name: source_id
fields.description: The dataset that carries the commentary; joins sources.source_id.

fields.name: locator
fields.description: File, row and column of the commentary in that dataset.

fields.name: source_sha256
fields.description: sha256 of the carrier file as retrieved.

fields.name: commentary_sha256
fields.description: sha256 of the exact commentary text that was parsed (UTF-8); null where the row is withheld.

fields.name: method
fields.description: Parser and version (tkcore/parimel_struct.py).

fields.name: model_generated
fields.description: Always false.
